name: Automated Lifestyles Hawaii
old_description: In today’s world of technology Home Automation has become the standard for convenient living. Initially know as Smart Home Technology, the use of a centralized control of your home features and devices began back in 1975. In the over 40 years since, smart home technology has developed to almost every room and utility in our homes. The dependable and high-quality devices offer not only convenience, but an unbelievable ease of operation. Home Automation systems are custom programmed to your lifestyle and your schedule. We at Automated Lifestyles Hawaii offering the best and latest technology to easily control everything in your home.
about:
Based in Honolulu, Hawaii, Automated Lifestyles Hawaii provides home automation services across the Hawaiian Islands. The company offers custom-programmed smart home systems tailored to individual lifestyles and schedules.

The firm specializes in audio and video installation, smart home integration, lighting control, motorized shades, and network infrastructure. Technicians design and install systems that centralize control of home features, from entertainment to environmental settings. Operations cover all major islands, with a showroom and office at 438 Hobron Lane in Honolulu.

Primary customers are residential homeowners seeking technology upgrades for convenience and energy management. The company also serves builders and remodelers who need integrated automation packages for new construction or renovation projects. Consultations are conducted in-home at no charge.

Automated Lifestyles Hawaii emphasizes its state contractor license (C-30961) and full insurance coverage as markers of reliability. The business was built on the premise that dependable, high-quality devices should deliver both convenience and ease of operation, a philosophy reflected in its custom programming approach.
